rows.name: Junior ADU
rows.note: Up to 500 sq ft, inside the house

A garage conversion, about one hundred twenty-five thousand dollars to two hundred fifty thousand dollars. An attached ADU, about two hundred thousand dollars to three hundred seventy-five thousand dollars. And a brand-new detached ADU runs about two hundred fifty thousand dollars to five hundred thousand dollars and up.

landscape.title: What drives ADU cost in Santa Monica

cards.desc: Utilities, deliveries & a separate front door

cards.name: Coastal Zone lots

cards.name: Panel upgrades

landscape.say: What drives the price in Santa Monica? Alley access: utilities, deliveries & a separate front door. Coastal Zone lots: some parcels need a Coastal Commission permit. Two-story units: structure, stairs & fire separation. Older slabs: postwar garages often need upgrades. Panel upgrades: a second kitchen needs more power. Finishes: kitchens & baths set the total.

landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Santa Monica ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And Santa Monica is one of the few cities where an ADU can be sold separately, as a condo.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than 4-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. ADUs of 750 square feet or less skip impact fees. And Santa Monica is one of the few cities where an ADU can be sold separately, as a condo.
